summary: Noble Corporation plc filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Noble Finance II LLC, priced an upsized offering of $800M in 6.250% Senior Notes due 2034 at par. Proceeds will redeem all outstanding 8.500% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2030 (from Diamond subsidiaries) and $300M of 8.950% Senior Notes due 2030. The offering is a routine debt refinancing, not a special-situation event. No M&A, activist, or restructuring triggers. Transaction expected to close June 11, 2026.
